# WritePixelFast64 〔BlitzLLVM〕

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Buffers and Pixels](BlitzBasic-Buffers-and-Pixels)

</div>


```blitzbasic
WritePixelFast64:Void x:Int32, y:Int32, buffer:Int32=0, red:Float16, green:Float16, blue:Float16, alpha:Float16
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `x` | In | Int32 | required | Horizontal position of the pixel. |
| `y` | In | Int32 | required | Vertical position of the pixel. |
| `buffer` | In | Int32 | `0` | The locked buffer to write to. Pass 0 for the current buffer. |
| `red` | In | Float16 | required | The red of the color, as a Float16. |
| `green` | In | Float16 | required | The green of the color, as a Float16. |
| `blue` | In | Float16 | required | The blue of the color, as a Float16. |
| `alpha` | In | Float16 | required | The alpha of the color, as a Float16. |

## Description

**〔BlitzLLVM〕** This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Sets a pixel of a locked buffer to a color given in the form of [WritePixel64](WritePixel64). The buffer has to be locked with [LockBuffer](LockBuffer) and the change shows when it is unlocked. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.
Writes the color of a pixel of a locked buffer from four half precision floats (Float16), like [WritePixel64](WritePixel64). The buffer has to be locked with [LockBuffer](LockBuffer). This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

## Differences

* A position outside of the buffer is ignored, and a buffer that is not locked is ignored by a build without `-d` and stops a debug build (`-d`) with an error message.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics3D 320, 240, 64, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
LockBuffer
For x = 0 To 255
	WritePixelFast64 x, 10, 0, x / 255.0, 0.25, 0.0, 1.0
Next
UnlockBuffer
Flip
WaitKey
```
